label: agg-two-equal-json-histograms
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT @hist AS d UNION ALL SELECT @hist) SELECT JSON_VALUE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d),'$.COUNT') AS sample_count,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d),99.0) AS p99 FROM h

label: agg-null-is-ignored
sql: WITH h AS (SELECT @hist AS d UNION ALL SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRING)) SELECT JSON_VALUE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d),'$.COUNT') AS sample_count,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(d),99.0) AS p99 FROM h

label: agg-null-json-result
sql: SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(CAST(NULL AS STRING)) IS NULL AS is_null

label: agg-null-percentile-guard
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(CAST(NULL AS STRING)) AS h) SELECT IF(h IS NULL,NULL,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(h,99.0)) AS p99 FROM a

label: agg-flatten-struct-empty
sql: SELECT (SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION[SAFE_OFFSET(0)])).COUNT AS sample_count FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE WHERE FALSE
